name: Elderwood Guardian Will

abilities.name: Emerald Vine Lash
abilities.effect: Thin emerald vines snap out of the grass at up to two foes: a light lash and a short snare.

abilities.name: Grass Burst Snare
abilities.effect: The aura bursts out under the feet through the grass: vines hold up to three foes for a moment.

acquire.equipPiece: One bark-and-vine bracer on a forearm with a single black blight vein under it; thin emerald second-skin glow, grass bursts under the feet.

abilities.name: Aura Twin Blades
abilities.effect: The coiling aura sharpens into dual blades and the holder flashes onto one target for a double cut.

abilities.name: Corrupted Coil Burst
abilities.effect: The thick aura coils out in a ring of thorned vines and blight, hitting everything around; it costs heavy strain because the will is corrupted.

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form treant-beastman: antler-branch crown, forest-green hair, hollow turquoise eyes, thorned bark armour on shoulders and back, root-toed digitigrade clawed greaves, vine-wrapped arms ending in two aura blades, a trailing vine tail and black blight veins over the chest.

equip.weapon: Twin emerald aura blades coiled from the vine-wrapped forearms (the Guardian's vine lance is the Mastery move).
equip.armor: Thorned bark armour: antler-branch crown, bark plates on shoulders and back, vine-bound bracers and root-toed greaves, black blight veins over the chest.
equip.hair_eyes: Hair turns forest-green, pale skin, hollow glowing turquoise eyes with markings.
equip.aura: Thick coiling emerald aura with black blight motes and falling leaves.

beastNote: Elderwood Guardian (corrupted S-class plant beast, centaur-like body of entangled vines)
lore: The will of a Vritra-corrupted, Hamadryad-like grove guardian. It lends vines and emerald aura, but it pushes back: a holder who is not trained enough is overwhelmed.
pitch: The Elderwood Guardian was a Vritra-corrupted S-class plant beast of entangled vines (a Hamadryad-like grove), and Tessia holds its will. Acquire keeps you human in a thin emerald second-skin glow with one equipped piece, a single bark-vine bracer, to lash and snare with vines. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a green-haired, turquoise-eyed treant-beastman in thorned bark armour with twin aura blades; it has the hardest control in the roster, no healing, and will overwhelm an untrained holder.
untrained: Hardest will to control in the roster. Canon: even a trained holder must train more or the corrupted will overwhelms them. DESIGN: highest strain of every will (Acquire 0.28, Integrate 1.4); past a strain threshold black blight veins climb the body, abilities cost extra strain and the vines turn on the holder (a short self-root); the awakening needs an outside flame in the core and a forced or neglected one can kill the host.

spirit.echo: A tall treant-beastman in thorned bark armour: antler-branch crowned head with forest-green hair and hollow turquoise eyes, bark-plated shoulders, vine-bound arms ending in twin aura blades, root-toed digitigrade legs, a trailing vine tail, black blight veins, a thick emerald aura.
spirit.look: A knotted heartwood orb with a cracked bark husk showing emerald glow, black blight veins crawling over it and a turquoise spark in the crack.
